analogy.rationale: SQLE and sterol demethylase (CYP51) act sequentially in the same ergosterol/cholesterol biosynthesis pathway, and HMGCR inhibitors block an upstream step of the same sterol-synthesis program, so their transcriptional responses should overlap strongly; LXR/FXR agonists and fatty acid synthase inhibitors perturb related lipid metabolic programs more weakly.
